test_cases.name: D4 audit: CDG routing broken — bash emits CDG-DEPS-DOWN nhung dim.json cdg=false
test_cases.description: Phase 2 D4 CRITICAL: wf-fix-probe-static-perf.sh (bash) tai line 210 emit signal voi cdg_flags: ['CDG-DEPS-DOWN'] khi performance dependency down. Nhung dim.json co cdg=false → CDG handler khong duoc dang ky → CDG flag bi IGNORE boi orchestrator → data loss khi dependencies down. IMP-QD4-004 (P0): fix cdg=true trong dim.json hoac xoa CDG emit tu bash.

input.scenario: P-QD4 bash probe detect performance dependency down (metrics server unavailable). Probe emit signal voi cdg_flags=['CDG-DEPS-DOWN']. dim.json co cdg=false.

expected.current_behavior: CDG flag emitted by bash but ignored by orchestrator (cdg=false in dim.json) → silent miss
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD4_004_option_a: dim.json cdg=true → orchestrator registers CDG handler → CDG flag processed
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD4_004_option_b: bash probe REMOVES cdg_flags emit → consistent with dim.json cdg=false
expected.risk: Performance issues during dependency outage silently undetected

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD4-004: cdg_flags='CDG-DEPS-DOWN' trong signal nhung orchestrator skip vi dim.json cdg=false → inconsistency. SAU IMP-QD4-004: phai chon 1 trong 2: (A) dim.json cdg=true + CDG handler dang ky, hoac (B) bash probe khong emit cdg_flags. IMP-024 CDG Governance (5-dim) merge cluster.

test_cases.name: D12 audit: --probe flag cosmetic — tat ca probes chay bat ke --probe value
test_cases.description: Phase 2 D12: wf-fix-probe-static-perf.sh co --probe argument (line 33 default + line 43 cosmetic parse) nhung Steps 1-3 (lines 100-217) deu unconditional — KHONG filter theo probe value. Nhap --probe=P-QD4-bundle-size nhung P-QD4-db-query-analysis van chay. IMP-QD4-012 (P2): implement actual probe filter trong bash scripts.

input.scenario: Spawn wf-fix-performance voi flag --probe=P-QD4-bundle-size. Ky vong chi bundle-size probe chay, con lai skip.

expected.current_behavior: ALL 6 probes run regardless of --probe flag (flag is cosmetic/ignored)
expected.expected_after_IMP_QD4_012: Only P-QD4-bundle-size runs; other probes skip with note 'filtered by --probe'

test_cases.validation: TRUOC IMP-QD4-012: lane chay 6 probes bat ke --probe value → token waste + slow. SAU IMP-QD4-012: --probe filter duoc honor, chi chay probe duoc chi dinh. DEVKIT-wide pattern: QD2/QD3/QD6 cung co cung D (--probe cosmetic).
